label: Fleeing to Cili
text: In 1945 the family flees west to Cili County for about six months, leaving its property behind.

label: Back to Taoyuan
text: After about half a year they come home, and the eldest son goes back to private school in the village.

label: Taoyuan to Changde
text: The year the family's property is confiscated, the eldest son finishes primary school and goes to middle school in Changde.

label: Changde to Wuhan
text: At sixteen he is admitted to an engineering college in Wuhan to study construction engineering.

label: Taoyuan to Changsha
text: The eldest daughter leaves home alone to study in Changsha and settles there. Year not recorded.

label: Wuhan to Ezhou
text: After graduating he joins a steel plant in Ezhou as a technician, and stays for forty-one years.

label: Village to town
text: Early 1980s. Part of the property is returned and the family moves from the village into the local town.

label: Ezhou to Wuhan
text: The third generation moves to Wuhan and settles there.

label: Wuhan to Montreal
text: The fourth generation goes abroad to study.
